create_CocoEvaluator: create a CocoEvaluator instance with ground truth COCO dataset and IoU types for detection evaluation
update_CocoEvaluator_predictions: update the CocoEvaluator with model predictions to accumulate per-image evaluation results across batches
summarize_CocoEvaluator_results: summarize the accumulated COCO evaluation results and print IoU metrics for each evaluation type
prepare_coco_detection_results: prepare model predictions in COCO detection format with bounding boxes, scores, and category labels
convert_boxes_to_xywh: convert bounding boxes from xyxy format to xywh format for COCO evaluation compatibility
